title: Falling With the Least Harm: How Long Before the Ground, Whether There Is Time to Recover, and Going Soft to Spread the Blow

questions.question: What decides between trying to recover and going soft?
options: Whether the time to the ground is more than a recovery step needs
How large the tilt is, whatever its rate
Whether the knees are cool enough to catch the body
How many feet are on the ground
questions.explanation: A recovery step takes about 0.30 s. With more time than that before the ground it is worth trying; with less the legs are made soft.

questions.question: The quick fall took how long to reach the ground?
questions.explanation: Tilted 23 degrees and turning at 3.0 rad/s it had 0.22 s. The slower fall, 17 degrees at 0.2 rad/s, had 0.38 s.

questions.question: What was the quick fall told to do?
options: Go soft (2)
Recover (1)
Nothing (0)
Fallen (3)
questions.explanation: 0.22 s is less than the 0.30 s a step needs. The slow fall, with 0.38 s, was told to recover.

questions.question: Soft legs gave a landing force of:
options: 1118 N, the same: the energy is the same
559 N, half
224 N, 5 times less
22 N, fifty times less
questions.explanation: The energy of the drop is the same, and force is energy over stroke. Five times the stroke, 0.10 m against 0.02 m, is a fifth of the force.

questions.question: Why is a tiny tilt not 'about to fall'?
options: A small tilt cannot be measured reliably
The balance control holds it, and the time to the ground only means something when it is not
The time to the ground is infinite below a threshold
The legs are soft at small tilts already
questions.explanation: The pendulum model has no controller in it, so it says every tilt ends on the ground. While the balance control is holding the body, that time means nothing.

questions.question: Should a robot that has fallen get straight up?
options: Yes, before the motors cool and stiffen
No: its motors may be hot or a leg bent; check first (36-02)
Yes, if it fell on level ground
Only after trying three times
questions.explanation: A fall may have bent something, and getting up is hard on motors that may already be hot. The machine of 36-02 checks before it tries.
